debate.entry_desc: A shorter, higher-tension What-If mode with proposition, opposition, a judge, and structured bets.
debate.entry_hint: Debate Arena usually resolves in 3-5 minutes, making it the fast path for verdicts, judge notes, and best arguments.
debate.runtime_preset_not_applicable: The three homepage oracle profiles only affect worldline branching in the main simulation. They do not change Debate Arena rules or adjudication.
debate.rules_body: Five fixed phases. Bets target either the winner or the verdict tone. Replay is phase-based, not branch-based.
debate.overview_room_detail: {{phase}} is on screen. {{unlocked}}/{{total}} phases are unlocked and {{count}} turns have been revealed.
debate.overview_judge_even: The room is still broadly balanced. No side has built a clean final verdict edge yet.
debate.overview_judge_edge: {{side}} currently owns a {{value}}-point edge on the live board.
debate.overview_judge_detail: {{pressure}} Watch {{watch}} if you want to see whether the next exchange locks the room or opens a comeback.
debate.overview_window_open_detail: The board is still open. {{next}} is the next checkpoint before the lock window closes.
debate.overview_window_locked_detail: {{phase}} has already pushed the room past the lock window. Read for verdict logic now, not late entry.
debate.overview_window_used_detail: A counterplay hedge is already logged for this room, so the remaining value is in tracking whether it actually lands.
debate.counterplay_balanced_summary: This phase is still trading evenly. A balance-tone hedge is the cleanest counterplay if you want protection before the lock window closes.
debate.counterplay_balanced_hint: Preset: verdict tone → balance at moderate confidence.
debate.counterplay_reversal_summary: {{side}} is trailing by {{value}} in this phase. If you expect a swingback, hedge on the trailing side before the lock window closes.
debate.counterplay_reversal_hint: Preset: winner → {{side}}, confidence {{confidence}}%. Use this when you expect a rebound rather than more momentum for the current leader.
debate.counterplay_used: Counterplay hedge logged for this debate.
debate.counterplay_unused: No counterplay hedge was used in this debate.
debate.watchlist_open: Bets are still open, so this phase is the right place to read winner momentum or verdict tone before the window closes.
debate.watchlist_locked: Betting is closed now. Focus on how this phase explains the final shape of the verdict instead of chasing a late pick.
debate.room_quote_waiting: This side has not established a fresh line in the current read yet.
debate.room_quote_judge: The judge is still absorbing pressure, trade-offs, and timing before making the room legible as a verdict.
debate.pressure_even: This phase is still trading evenly, with neither side holding a clean scoring edge yet.
debate.pressure_edge: {{side}} has pushed a +{{value}} swing in this phase, which is enough to feel like real pressure.
debate.stage_map_subtitle: Use this as a quick scan of where each phase opened, where it tilted, and which beats are still just setup.
debate.clash_opening: This phase is about framing the worldline. Whoever makes the cleaner premise first usually owns the first impression.
debate.clash_crossfire: This is the vulnerability check. Exposing a weak assumption, thin evidence base, or hidden cost can rewrite the whole debate.
debate.clash_rebuttal: Now adaptability matters. The side that can absorb a hit and reframe it into a stronger line is the one most likely to swing or stabilize the board.
debate.clash_closing: The endgame is compression. The question is which side can turn earlier points into one memorable, actionable conclusion.
debate.clash_verdict: The verdict phase is no longer about volume. It is about which side left the judge with the more actionable consequence at the decisive turn.
debate.bet_kind_winner_hint: Use this when you think you know which side will actually carry the final verdict.
debate.bet_kind_tone_hint: Use this when you trust the judge's tone more than a specific winner call.
debate.result_predictions_hit_rate: {{value}}% of bets landed on the final call.
debate.result_predictions_empty: No one took a position before the lock window closed.
debate.result_counterplay_none: No counterplay hedge was recorded, so the room resolves on the base verdict only.
debate.result_empty_predictions: No bets were placed for this debate.
debate.result_pending: This debate result is still being prepared.

debate.result_missing: This debate does not have a result payload yet.
debate.bet_error_locked: Betting is already locked for this debate.
